metadata.name: 假如我直接赢 - just win 1
metadata.description:
1.房间里的普通低品质道具会换成 3 或 4 级道具。 2.保留任务道具和凑齐变身套装所需的低品质道具。 3.打标的时候也会为高品质候选较少的存档补充尚未解锁的 3、4 级道具。
1. Regular low-quality items in rooms are replaced with Quality 3 or Quality 4 items. 2. Quest items and lower-quality items needed to complete transformations are preserved. 3. On saves with few high-quality items available, Quality 3 and 4 items you haven't unlocked yet can also appear while you go for completion marks.
